meta.title: Generic QD 5.56 mm suppressor on the HK416 D14.5RS: gas dynamics, sound, back-pressure, heat, flash
meta.model: lumped-parameter; see README.md for the physics, sources and limits
meta.frame: metres, +Z down-range, +Y up, +X to the shooter's left; origin at socket_mount = the HK416 socket_muzzle
meta.time_zero: the bullet base leaving the barrel crown (HK416 events.bullet_exit); add hk416.exit_after_sear_s for the HK416Action clock
meta.units: SI unless a key says otherwise

bullet_ramp.note: bullet-base travel over which an aperture goes from annulus to fully open: aperture radius plus the 2.5 mm boat tail

cd_muzzle.note: the HK416 action empties the bore through a sonic muzzle with no contraction; kept so the bare case reproduces it

cd_aperture.note: discharge coefficient of a sharp-edged aperture (0.8 to 0.85 choked); the HK416 action uses 0.8 for its orifices

cd_breech.note: discharge coefficient of the leak round the withdrawing case

stanton.note: Stanton number of the wall heat transfer; turbulent duct flow gives 0.003 to 0.005, impinging jets more

h_free.note: heat transfer of the gas left stirring in the can once the through-flow stops

t_ign.note: temperature above which the air in the can burns the fuel-rich propellant gas (H2/CO-air autoignition is about 850 to 900 K)

tau_burn.note: time constant of that burn once alight

q_o2.note: heat released per kg of oxygen consumed (Thornton's rule; Huggett 1980, Fire and Materials 4)

tau_ac.note: acoustic transit time across the exit aperture (7.2 mm / 343 m/s): the shortest rise the exit can radiate as a compact source

carry_gamma_phi.note: limiting plume angle of the muzzle source flow for gamma 1.24, extrapolated from Ashkenas and Sherman (1966): 1.365, 1.662, 1.888 rad for gamma 1.67, 1.40, 1.29

clip_factor.note: share of the in-line kinetic-energy carry-over that survives the clips and the under-expansion of the jets; solved for the published peak reduction at 1 m

target_reduction_db.note: midpoint of the 20 to 25 dB peak reduction at 1 m left of the muzzle for AR-15 rifles with 14 suppressors (Lobarinas et al. 2016, as summarised in the NIOSH review)

target_ear_reduction_db.note: midpoint of the 17 to 24 dB peak reduction at the shooter's ear (Murphy et al. 2018, Int. J. Audiology 57 S1, abstract)

dipole_share.note: share of the compact thrust dipole that radiates (the starting jet is not compact, so less than 1); solved for the published peak reduction at the shooter's ear

bare_side_db.note: bare rifle at 1 m, 90 degrees: assets/hk416/sound (M4, M855, 14.5 in; Dater, "Firearm Sound Briefing")

mu_bare.note: directivity parameter of the bare muzzle blast in assets/hk416/sound (Fansler and Schmidt)

theta_shooter_deg.note: shooter's ear from the bore line, assets/hk416/sound

theta_bystander_deg.note: bystander 5 m to the right, assets/hk416/sound

theta_downrange_deg.note: listener 50 m down-range, 2 m off the line, assets/hk416/sound

warm_wall.note: wall temperature of the reference "subsequent shot" state (a few rounds in)

hot_wall.note: wall temperature of the "hot can" state (about 60 rounds in)

h_conv.note: free convection from a 38 mm horizontal cylinder in still air (Churchill-Chu order of magnitude)

tau_o2.note: time for fresh air to refill a can left open to the air: a guess, design dependent

case_taper.note: half-angle taper of the 5.56x45 case body (9.58 mm at the head to 8.99 mm at the shoulder over 36.5 mm)

neck_leak.note: leak round the case neck as soon as the case starts back: 6.43 mm neck, 0.05 mm fired clearance

port_d_thrust.note: HK416 gas port diameter re-solved with the residual-thrust term on, for the same bare cyclic rate as the shipped action (so the bare rifle does not change)

residual_thrust.note: share of residual bore pressure times case-head area that pushes the bolt once the lugs are clear

case_seal_len.note: case travel over which the neck still seals the chamber (5.1 mm neck plus the shoulder)

flash_mix_ratio.note: air needed to burn the fuel-rich exhaust, about stoichiometric for 50 to 60 % CO + H2 by volume

flash_t_ign.note: ignition temperature of the exhaust-air mixture (order given by Klingenberg and Heimerl 1992; recalled, not re-read)

breech.note: leak area (m2) from the bore past the withdrawing case against time since the bullet left the crown, from the HK416 action run with and without the can

model.note: from model/geom.py: what a page needs to draw the section and play the QD clips. Polygons are (s, r) in mm, s = z*1000 + s_mount.

lock_collar.role: locking collar: a 60 degree turn cams the three jaws shut behind the flash hider

mount_body.role: mount: seats over the flash hider and closes the rear of the blast chamber

blast_baffle.role: blast baffle: the first and thickest cone, no clip

baffle_2.role: cone baffle 2 of 6 with its spacer skirt; clip at 90 degrees

baffle_3.role: cone baffle 3 of 6 with its spacer skirt; clip at 270 degrees

baffle_4.role: cone baffle 4 of 6 with its spacer skirt; clip at 90 degrees

baffle_5.role: cone baffle 5 of 6 with its spacer skirt; clip at 270 degrees

baffle_6.role: cone baffle 6 of 6 with its spacer skirt; clip at 90 degrees

end_cap.role: end cap with the exit aperture and six spanner notches

jaw.role: locking jaw: closes on the jam ring behind the flash hider, so the hider cannot pull out

socket_mount.note: mates to the rifle's socket_muzzle (the tip of the flash hider) with an identity transform

socket_exit.note: centre of the end-cap aperture: the new muzzle for flash, smoke, sound and the bullet

socket_thermal.note: top of the tube over the blast baffle: the hottest skin, for glow and mirage

qd_attach.note: the open can is slid back over the flash hider until the mount seats on the hider shoulder, then the collar is turned 60 degrees: its cam drives the three jaws in behind the hider

qd_detach.note: the reverse: collar turned open, jaws out, can drawn forward off the hider

states.note: first_round: cold can full of air. subsequent: a few rounds in, can full of spent gas, 320 K wall (the reference state). hot: 600 K wall.

sound.note: Peak levels of the muzzle (exit) source. pop = the uncorking pulse, hump = the swell after it, both at 1 m; levels at the HK416 listeners use its path lengths. The N-wave of the bullet is not changed.

behind_1m.note: bare level from the HK416 directivity law at 180 degrees, both at 1 m from their own source
bare level from the HK416 directivity law at 180 degrees, both at 1 m from their own source
bare level from the HK416 directivity law at 180 degrees, both at 1 m from their own source

flash.note: Interface for assets/hk416/flash (not on this branch when this was built): multiply each phase of the bare flash by scale[phase], move the source to socket_exit, delay it by delay_s.

heat.note: Bulk can temperature. shot heat by wall temperature is in config.heat; strings below are still-air cooling.

action.note: HK416 action (assets/hk416/action/sim.py run) driven by the bore pressure, gas temperature and exit thrust of core.py. overlay holds the blocks of action.json for the suppressed rifle.

supp_gas_only.label: suppressed, no residual thrust, shipped port

input.note: blowdown tables against time since the bullet left the crown: what replaces the tail of the HK416 interior-ballistics tables (pbr, tg, fg) when the can is fitted

overlay.note: Blocks of assets/hk416/action/action.json recomputed with the suppressor fitted (same format and units). Merge over the base file and pass to HK416Action.use().

cycle.note: semi, shouldered. carrier_mm rearward travel; bolt_deg 0 locked, 22.5 unlocked; hammer_deg 0 on the sear, positive towards the firing pin, negative overcocked under the carrier; firing_pin_mm forward travel from its rearmost position (primer contact at fp_float); receiver_force_N rearward axial force on the gun body from bore and action, averaged over each sample (a rigid mount would feel this) With the suppressor fitted.

ballistics.note: t0 is charge ignition, seconds after sear release; with the suppressor the bore empties into the can

events.note: seconds after sear release, one semi shot, shouldered, suppressor fitted

auto.note: auto fire: the carrier trips the auto sear on closing; period is sear release to sear release

series.note: the reference shot (subsequent) and the first round, for plots: chamber pressures (Pa), exit flow, sound pressure at 1 m (mono = all directions, dip = times cos(theta))
